ETH.note: Nothing on a national cyber body or strategy.
The Communications Authority is only designated in a final draft proclamation, not in an enacted law.

facts.fact: Ethiopanorama reports that a parliamentary session on 10 January 2024 discussed the final draft Personal Data Protection proclamation, drafted by the Ministry of Innovation and Technology and first floated in 2020.

ETH.note: Disability rights is raised only on the age limit of the data draft; nothing on accessible information or services.
Nothing on the national ID system.
